notes.title: Game Release!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Brendan from the Asset Cannon development team here to welcome you all to Axecutioners! Thank you all so much for your patience in waiting for our Steam debut, we have been hard at work ironing out our final bugs and making sure this experience was as optimal as possible!

Known issues:


 Players are currently experiencing issues joining each other using the in-game Steam Lobbies. (Steam Remote Play Local is a work-around for this while we work on a fix for this, but there may be a little bit of lag depending on the geographical distance between players)


We will keep you all updated with any fixes that go out. We would also love to hear your feedback, so please feel free to leave us a review or let us know what you think in the Community tab!

Thank you all again, and we hope you enjoy our game! Axe on everyone!
